data.title: Rove Home Marasi Drive
data.about:
Setting new standards of innovative living, Rove Home Marasi Drive is the latest project of IRTH Development, located in the popular community of Business Bay. The developer aims to create a luxury tower that offers residents many perks, from smart residential spaces to enriching amenities. Rove Home will provide residents with studio,1, 2 bedroom apartments.

The design features that make this property unique are the generous ceiling heights, intelligent space planning, and seamless indoor and outdoor integration. The Rove Home Marasi Drive property is near popular tourist spots like Dubai Mall and City Walk, with easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road.  

The amenities are distributed across ground floor, podium floor, sky garden, and rooftop level. Homeowners will also enjoy a green landscape along with numerous benefits across Rove Hotels properties.

characteristics_module.title: Enhance your daily life with innovation and smart home solutions
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• A well-connected location in proximity to key areas and landmarks 
  • Fully furnished studio, 1 and 2-bed unit
  • Rove-inspired design comprising cozy relaxation areas and vibrant art installations 
  • Showcase smart and adaptable living solutions provided by ORI.
  • Unique and personalized living spaces boasting natural light and unmatched panoramic cityscape views
  • Numerous amenities available on the ground floor, as well as on the indoor and outdoor podium levels.
  • Easily accessible through Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road

location_tile.title: Experience the vibrant lifestyle beyond the ordinary at Rove Home Marasi Drive
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled along Marasi Drive, this development overlooks the iconic Dubai Canal in Business Bay. Its strategic location provides swift access to Al Asayel Street, seamlessly connecting to Al Khail Road. Additionally, residents enjoy effortless proximity to Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro.

  • 8 minutes - Dubai Mall
  • 10 minutes - Rove Downtown Hotel
  • 11 minutes - Dubai Opera
  • 12 minutes - DIFC
  • 16 minutes - Dubai International Airport
